arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/vps-coordinator-scope.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 2 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 9fc305d4a813d0cc0f24434627fa4c31cd1773cf
echo AUDIT_GIT_MAIN="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'AUDIT_IDENTITY='; id -un
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re,subprocess
tracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files'],text=True).splitlines()
print('TOTAL_TRACKED',len(tracked),flush=True)
for prefix in ('ops/coordinator_','ops/coordinator-','ops/tests/test_coordinator','ops/tests/test_portable_coordinator','ops/chatgpt_coordinator','ops/chatgpt_media','ops/chatgpt_attachment','ops/telegram_coordinator','ops/codex','ops/supervisor','rea-linux/'):
 matching=[p for p in tracked if p.startswith(prefix)]
 print('FILES_PREFIX',prefix,len(matching),','.join(matching[:75]),flush=True)
target='ops/coordinator_ai.py'
for path in tracked:
 if path.endswith(('.py','.sh','.yml','.yaml','.md','.json')) and not path.startswith('rea-linux/'):
  f=Path(path)
  try: text=f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
  except (UnicodeError,OSError): continue
  refs= [key for key in ('coordinator_ai','coordinator_phase_continuation','coordinator-owner-order','coordinator-ai-smoke','coordinator-private-media-relay','telegram-coordinator-owner','coordinator_smoke','codex-autonomous.yml','codex-chatgpt-bridge.yml','agent-switch.yml') if key in text]
  if refs and (path.startswith('ops/') or path.startswith('.github/workflows/')):
   print('CODE_REF',path,','.join(refs),flush=True)
for name in ('coordinator-owner-order.yml','coordinator-ai-smoke.yml','coordinator-private-media-relay.yml','coordinator-phase-cycle.yml','telegram-coordinator-owner.yml','agent-switch.yml','codex-autonomous.yml','codex-chatgpt-bridge.yml','codex-project-leader-safe-fix.yml','cloud-supervisor-observation.yml','telegram-codex-gateway.yml','codex-quota-watch.yml'):
 f=Path('.github/workflows')/name
 if not f.exists(): continue
 data=f.read_text().splitlines()
 i=next((i for i,s in enumerate(data) if s=='on:'),-1)
 end=next((k for k in range(i+1,len(data)) if data[k]=='permissions:' or data[k]=='jobs:'),min(len(data),i+35))
 events=[x for x in data[i+1:end] if re.match(r'^  [a-z_]+:',x)]
 print('WORKFLOW_EVENTS',name,','.join(x.strip() for x in events),flush=True)
print('REA_AUDIT_SCOPE_PASS',flush=True)
PY
